vocab.definition: the solvent that moves through the paper.
distance by spot ÷ distance by solvent.
produces a single spot on a chromatogram.

misconceptions.wrong: Use a pen to draw the start line.
misconceptions.right: Use pencil — ink would separate too.

misconceptions.wrong: The solvent level starts above the spots.
misconceptions.right: Solvent must start BELOW the spots.
